profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at KBR, Inc.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
● Led front-end builds for high-profile clients such as Intel, Riverbed, and Hortonworks.
● Produced 50+ microsites and landing pages with responsive layouts, improved SEO, and
fast-loading assets.
● Introduced modern JS development workflows to boost performance and code quality

positions.title: Web Intern at Kno, Inc.
positions.description:
•	UI development for various products. 
•	Updated existing application using SQL to get raw data from database and display it in an organized and appealing manner.  
•	Work with internal JS library as well as jQuery, css3 and html5

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
•	Work as front-end developer on various large scale web base applications for SJSU as well as maintaining AS SJSU website
•	Used content management system Adobe Contribute to manage content coming from different departments of San Jose State University
•	Responsible to meet section 508 standards for audience accessibility
•	Develop responsive components and migrated content from table base layouts.

positions.title: Feelance Web Development/Design
positions.description:
•	Freelance web developer working on multiple projects on short and long-term contracts
•	Develop multiple websites for various clients using html, css and JavaScript as well as CMS WordPress and computer graphics software
•	Acquired web development experience to be able to perform well as a developer in a professional environment

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: • Promoting sales and public interest of the company by presentation of products and positive interaction with customers

positions.title: Shift Manager
positions.description:
• Tracking company supplies, managing the business paperwork, and training new employees in an efficient and caring manner
• Increased sales and public interest by promoting customer service and efficiency among employees
